eventDetail.scope: The conference covers advances in Information Systems, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Human–Computer Interaction, and Computer Systems & Networks, with emphasis on governance, architecture, and innovation. It welcomes research on IT governance, e-government, enterprise architecture, and strategic IS/IT management, alongside software design, testing, verification, and development methodologies. In AI and Data Science, topics include machine learning, NLP, multimodal retrieval, semantic web, and multiagent systems. Emerging technologies such as IoT, smart sensor networks, AR/VR, social computing, and bioinformatics are encouraged. Cross-field applications—health, education, GIS, and cultural heritage—highlight the conference’s focus on impactful, interdisciplinary digital transformation.
